mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_personal_token ( user_personal_token_id, user_id, access_token, scope, created_at, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{user_personal_token_id}, #{user_id}, #{access_token}, #{scope}, NOW(), #{expired_at} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_token = #{access_token}, scope = #{scope}, expired_at = #{expired_at}
mapper.select: SELECT user_personal_token_id as userPersonalTokenId, user_id as userId, access_token as accessToken, scope, created_at as createdAt, expired_at as expiredAt FROM user_personal_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pr.project_repo_id as projectRepoId, pr.project_id as projectId, pr.github_repository_id as githubRepositoryId, pr.repo_owner as repoOwner, pr.repo_name as repoName, pr.default_branch as defaultBranch, pr.github_app_installation_id as githubAppInstallationId FROM project_repository pr INNER JOIN project_user pu ON pr.project_id = pu.project_id WHERE pu.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pr.project_repo_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_repository ( project_id, github_repository_id, repo_owner, repo_name, default_branch, github_app_installation_id ) VALUES ( #{project_id}, #{github_repository_id}, #{repo_owner}, #{repo_name}, #{default_branch}, #{github_app_installation_id} )
mapper.update: UPDATE project_repository SET repo_owner = #{repo_owner}, repo_name = #{repo_name}, default_branch = #{default_branch}, github_app_installation_id = #{github_app_installation_id} WHERE project_repo_id = #{project_repo_id}
mapper.select: SELECT pr.project_repo_id, pr.project_id, pr.github_repository_id, pr.repo_owner, pr.repo_name, pr.default_branch, pr.github_app_installation_id, p.project_name, p.description as project_description FROM project_repository pr INNER JOIN project p ON pr.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pr.github_repository_id = #{githubRepoId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repository_branch ( project_repo_id, branch_name, created_at, base_sha ) VALUES ( #{projectRepoId}, #{branchName}, NOW(), #{baseSha} )
INSERT INTO github_webhook ( project_repo_id, hook_id, events, config_url, created_at ) VALUES ( #{projectRepoId}, #{hookId}, #{events}, #{configUrl}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT gw.github_webhook_id, gw.project_repo_id, gw.hook_id, gw.events, gw.config_url, gw.created_at, pr.repo_owner, pr.repo_name, pr.github_repository_id FROM github_webhook gw INNER JOIN project_repository pr ON gw.project_repo_id = pr.project_repo_id WHERE pr.github_repository_id = #{githubRepoId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO github_app_token ( project_repo_id, app_token, expired_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{projectRepoId}, #{appToken}, #{expiredAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT github_app_token_id as githubAppTokenId, project_repo_id as projectRepoId, app_token as appToken, expired_at as expiredAt, created_at as createdAt FROM github_app_token WHERE project_repo_id = #{projectRepoId} AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > NOW()) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pr.project_repo_id, pr.repo_owner, pr.repo_name, pr.github_app_installation_id, gat.app_token is not null as has_app_token, gat.expired_at as token_expires_at, gw.github_webhook_id is not null as has_webhook, COUNT(DISTINCT rb.repo_branch_id) as branch_count FROM project_repository pr LEFT JOIN github_app_token gat ON pr.project_repo_id = gat.project_repo_id AND (gat.expired_at IS NULL OR gat.expired_at > NOW()) LEFT JOIN github_webhook gw ON pr.project_repo_id = gw.project_repo_id LEFT JOIN repository_branch rb ON pr.project_repo_id = rb.project_repo_id WHERE pr.project_repo_id = #{projectRepoId} GROUP BY pr.project_repo_id

SELECT 'GitHub Integration Service' as service_name, NOW() as current_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_personal_token) as connected_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_repository WHERE github_repository_id IS NOT NULL) as connected_repositories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM github_webhook) as active_webhooks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM github_app_token WHERE expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > NOW()) as valid_app_tokens, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_branch WHERE created_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) as branches_created_24h
